name: How long does it take to install decorative millwork?
description: Installation time depends on project scope, complexity, and area size. Clear access and pre-installation prep can shorten the timeline.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install decorative millwork?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for decorative millwork installation varies based on the project's scope, the complexity of the chosen profiles, and the size of the area being renovated. A small room with basic crown molding might take a day or two, while an entire home with intricate wainscoting and casings could span several days or even weeks. Process clarity regarding timing often depends on pre-installation preparation; ensuring the space is clear and accessible allows our team to work more efficiently, potentially reducing the overall project duration. Unforeseen issues like wall imperfections can also add to the timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time depends on project scope, complexity, and area size. Clear access and pre-installation prep can shorten the timeline.
